name: IconTile
description: A neutral square holding an icon, sized like an avatar: 19, 27, 35 or 51. It is decorative beside its words, so it is hidden from assistive tech; a tile that means something on its own takes `role="img"` and an `aria-label`, and is announced.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.
